name: robots/alexanderkeijzer__ros-gym-env-webots
title: Webots gym_env Panda bridge
intro: Webots gym_env Panda bridge, adapted from alexanderkeijzer/ros-gym-env-webots. It reads `read_joint_positions` and `read_reward`; runs `act_and_step`, `step_simulation` and `reset_simulation`. `act_and_step`: publish one normalized nine-joint action vector, request one Webots time_step and read the joint positions after it; a failure after the publication is an unknown outcome, and the observation does not prove that the node applied the action before the step. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
